observations.finding: Only WORLD_SURFACE=1, MOTION_BLOCKING=4, MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES=5 use CLIENT; worldgen/live-world entries are not sent.
WORLD_SURFACE uses non-air; MOTION_BLOCKING uses blocksMotion OR nonempty fluid; NO_LEAVES requires the same motion condition AND block not an instance of LeavesBlock.
Each map tracks 256 columns indexed x+16*z; highest matching y produces y+1 first-available height, represented relative to chunk minimum Y.

BlockStateBase.initCache sets block-derived fluid state, chooses a static collision-shape cache only for nondynamic shapes, then stores calculateSolid() into legacySolid. blocksMotion is false for COBWEB and BAMBOO_SAPLING regardless of cached solidity.

forceSolidOn precedes forceSolidOff; absent overrides, null cache and empty collision shape return false; nonempty cached shape tests its bounding box with size threshold 0.7291666666666666 OR vertical extent at least 1.0.
The block-state fluid reference is initialized from the owning block's getFluidState(state), not inferred from an immutable block name or nonair bit.
FluidState.isEmpty delegates to the concrete owner Fluid.isEmpty; the owner method and concrete default need their own source closure.
LeavesBlock.getFluidState returns the water source for WATERLOGGED and otherwise delegates to the generic block; NO_LEAVES excludes a leaf even when waterlogged.

source_delegate_closure.reason: FluidState.isEmpty dispatches to an owner implementation; concrete EMPTY and water behavior not proven by these files.
The exact collision-shape bounding box fed to calculateSolid comes from this delegate.

Vertical threshold uses bounding box Y extent.
The cache initialization path uses this predicate to decide whether to create shape cache.
Block-specific collision shapes and property overrides determine cached solidity.
The two named exceptions and registered default block-properties need exact class/static initialization identity.
One-time cache initialization and exact canonical state ID epoch must be bound to the official 32,366-state runtime probe.
